rows.text: ...The pre-sale for the captain's merchandise has started. Why is the merchandise so popular? It's because the captain is too charming! *cough*... Well, the current captain... That's me! Soooo...
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Captain, we meet again! Have you come specially to see me? Or is anything the matter?
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Can you please talk to me a little more? I love your unique pronunciation and really want to learn it.
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Let out a really cool sounding *hmph*?
Let out a really cool sounding *hmph*!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: !drawkcab siht taeper uoy fi loof a er'uoY
Captain, I'm not a fool! Don't bully me like this! Look at the portrait on me. If you bully me, it'll be just like bullying yourself!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: How's business after using my portrait?
I don't know the detailed statistics, but I seem to be attracting many people. I heard from the crew that the pre-sale seems to be very popular.
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Please say something else. Your voice is so beautiful that I want to hear more!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: I don't have anything else to say.
*sigh* Your voice is still more beautiful... I'll have to work harder and practice more.
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: Captain, let's catch up another time. I'll go back to advertising.
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"

rows.text: ...Welcome everyone! [Trailblazer], your current captain, wishes everyone a great time on board the ship!
rows.speaker: "Mini Captain"
